editorial_intro: Akshay Kumar's blockbuster horror-comedy Bhooth Bangla finally hits Netflix, Ali Fazal goes dark in the 1970s thriller Raakh, and Karisma Kapoor's crime comeback Brown is still the talk of the town.

picks.title: Bhooth Bangla
picks.synopsis: Akshay Kumar plays Arjun, who inherits a haunted ancestral palace in Mangalpur and plans his sister's wedding there — only to face a terrifying local legend about a demon that targets newlywed brides. The Priyadarshan reunion that earned ₹264 crore at the box office.
picks.why_watch: The Akshay-Priyadarshan magic is back — Hera Pheri fans, this one's for you. A certified blockbuster finally on your couch.

picks.title: Raakh
picks.synopsis: Set in 1970s Delhi, a sub-inspector investigates the disappearance of two teenage girls — only to uncover a disturbing conspiracy that drags him into the darkest corners of human depravity. From the creator of Paatal Lok.
picks.why_watch: If Paatal Lok had you glued to the screen, Prosit Roy's new series digs even darker. Ali Fazal brings the intensity.

picks.title: Brown
picks.synopsis: Karisma Kapoor plays Rita Brown, a troubled Anglo-Indian detective in Kolkata battling alcoholism while investigating the murder of a young woman from a powerful family. A neo-noir psychological thriller adapted from Abheek Barua's novel City of Death.
picks.why_watch: Karisma's OTT debut is gritty, de-glam, and Kolkata-drenched. A proper comeback role with real teeth.

picks.title: Dridam
picks.synopsis: A rookie sub-inspector gets posted to a peaceful village in Idukki, Kerala — until murders and a bank robbery shatter the calm. With pressure mounting from all sides, he races to untangle a web of dark secrets.
picks.why_watch: Malayalam cinema's investigative thriller tradition continues. Shane Nigam in cop mode is compelling viewing.

picks.title: Maa Hai Na
picks.synopsis: Shilpa Shetty hosts this lively cooking reality show where Gen Z celebrities team up with their mothers for culinary challenges — equal parts chaos, love, and generational clashes in the kitchen.
picks.why_watch: Light, warm, and exactly the kind of maa-beta chaos that'll make you call your mom.

picks.title: Gullak Season 5
picks.synopsis: The beloved Mishra family returns with another season of heartfelt middle-class stories. New challenges, evolving relationships, and the same warmth that made Gullak a comfort-watch staple.
picks.why_watch: Five seasons in and the Mishras still feel like your neighbours. India's most comforting show is back.

picks.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
picks.synopsis: After crossing ₹1,100 crore at the box office, the blockbuster Spy Universe sequel finally hits OTT. Hamza Ali Mazari embarks on a new high-stakes espionage mission that redefines the franchise.
picks.why_watch: The biggest Hindi film of the year is now streamable. If you somehow missed this in theatres, your couch awaits.

picks.title: Norway: The Dark Horse
picks.synopsis: An inside look at Norway's men's national football team and their emotional return to a major international tournament after 26 years. Features Erling Haaland and Martin Ødegaard preparing for the 2026 World Cup.
picks.why_watch: With the World Cup fever building, this is your backstage pass to one of football's most exciting comeback stories.

picks.title: Every Year After
picks.synopsis: Percy and Sam go from childhood friends to lovers over several idyllic summers in Canada's Barry Bay. When a dark secret tears them apart, Percy must return years later to face her first love. Based on Carley Fortune's bestselling novel.
picks.why_watch: A lazy summer romance that hits different when the weather's warm. Grab a blanket and let the nostalgia wash over you.

picks.title: Sweet Magnolias Season 5
picks.synopsis: The beloved South Carolina trio — Maddie, Dana Sue, and Helen — return for another season of balancing careers, relationships, and family. All 10 episodes drop at once for a perfect weekend binge.
picks.why_watch: The ultimate comfort binge returns with 10 new episodes. The Southern charm hasn't worn off.
